propositions: Code-review gate cannot block consequential test-sufficiency findings because code-v3 impact model discards verifier's prod_impact and trigger_likelihood judgments for maint-lane findings.

A commit shipped a contract allowing stale>0 and a co-shipped test asserting stale=0 (contradictory) was not caught because the tests binary scored ~0.30 under code-v3's churn dampener, below advisory threshold.

Code-v4 must introduce lane-scoped impact scoring: serious-maint undamped, moderate-maint keyed to prod_impact (high/med=1.0, low=0.6, none=0.5), debt churn-amplified only; tests threshold raised to 0.54 to capture moderate-maint findings.

New antipattern forbids_contract_allowed_state must detect when a test forbids a state the same diff's contract declares allowed, with both halves quoted verbatim and a guard excluding stated deliberate tightening.

Prod_impact and trigger_likelihood field descriptions must be re-scoped to rate the guarded path's user-facing reach (for maintainability findings), replacing the test-only-implies-none clause, codifying how verifiers already populate these fields.

Replay of code-v3 corpus (1881 sidecars, 3384 findings) must show zero demotion of currently-blocking findings while v4+tests@0.54 blocks 99 changes (8.0% vs 3.4% baseline) with no new validity floor violations.
